scope: Local dependency-closed source bundles and synthetic structural gate probes, not model review.

interpretation.sourceEntries: A source entry is one path and revision, not necessarily one unique file path.
interpretation.coverage: All captured parent source entries are assigned to at least one dependency-closed partition. Changed before/after sources, trusted base policy context, prior-finding context, and their forward dependencies are shared.
interpretation.gate: Synthetic complete reports exercise the deterministic aggregation contract only. A synthetic pass is neither model output, semantic review, nor PR approval.
interpretation.cost: Shared context repeats across packets. Unique source bytes stay within the unchanged parent cap, while cumulative packet bytes are larger. No model token, latency, or cost measurement was performed.
interpretation.limitations: Static import planning is not complete semantic impact analysis. Runtime-only wiring can still require missing context. Irreducible dependency closures, total-byte overflow, and incomplete reviewer reports remain fail-closed. Actual provider input/token limits remain unverified.
